about: SKN Sinhgad College of Engineering, Pandharpur established by Savitribai Phule Shikshan Prasarak Mandal (SPSPM), SKNSCOE Library is one of the best engineering college libraries in the state. It started its function with a vision to serve the information needs of its users and it mainly holds books related to engineering and allied subjects & discipline like Mechanical, Civil, Computer, and Electronics & Telecommunication & Electrical. We added new sections like competitive exam its realms. Library also plays a vital role in acquisition, organization and dissemination of knowledge. SKN Sinhgad College of Engineering, College library system supports the teaching-learning program of institute.

general: Registered members are issued a library borrow card which is non-transferable.
Members should produce their ID cards at the entrance.
Strict silence must be observed and mobile phones switched off.
Borrowers must check physical condition of books before borrowing.
Members are responsible for books issued against their lost tickets.
Overdue charges apply for late returns.
Personal books, printed material, bags, mobile, etc. are not allowed inside and must be kept at the Property Counter (at owner's risk).
Readers should not write in, mark, or damage books or furniture.
rules_and_regulations.circulation_issue_system: Books will be issued on presentation of the library card. Students are responsible for any damage noticed at the time of return.
rules_and_regulations.overdue_charges: Books issued for 7 days. Fine of Rs. 2 per day per book from the due date.
rules_and_regulations.book_lost: Borrower shall replace the book with the same or latest edition or pay double the cost after permission from the librarian.
rules_and_regulations.care_of_cards: Do not fold or alter cards. Members are responsible for all cards issued to them.
rules_and_regulations.loss_of_cards: Report loss to librarian in writing. A replacement card can be issued on payment of Rs. 50/- per card after checking borrowing register.
rules_and_regulations.validity_of_cards: Valid for the respective academic year only. Cards must be returned at the end of the academic year.
rules_and_regulations.care_of_library_books: Handle books/journals carefully. Marking, writing, tearing pages, or mutilation is strictly prohibited and the reader will be held responsible.
rules_and_regulations.no_due_certificate: Each student must obtain a No dues certificate from the library after returning all books, surrendering cards, and paying any outstanding dues.
